# Heavyweight Linemen

> Heavyweight Linemen is an offensive line training academy in Salinas, California. We coach youth (ages 10–13) and high school (ages 14–18) football linemen in pass protection, run blocking, footwork, hand placement, leverage, and lineman-specific strength and conditioning — in small groups (3–6 athletes) or one-on-one sessions.

Key facts:

- Location: Salinas, California (serving Monterey County and the Central Coast)
- Contact: contact@heavyweightlineman.com
- Coaches: Antonio Velasquez (Head Coach, OL/DL, coaching since 2010) and Uli Paiz (Lead Instructor, OL/DL specialist, coaching since 2012, Monterey County All-Star Game offensive line coach)
- Focus: offensive line technique first, with defensive line training also available
- Session length: 60–90 minutes; flexible scheduling with weekend and evening availability
- Equipment provided: heavy bags, leverage tools, functional strength equipment
- Pricing: contact for program pricing and package options

## Programs

- [Youth Development (Ages 10–13)](https://heavyweightlineman.com/#programs): stance mechanics, basic footwork, introduction to blocking technique, strength foundations
- [High School Training (Ages 14–18)](https://heavyweightlineman.com/#programs): advanced pass protection, run blocking schemes, strength and power development, film study, college preparation
- [Position-Specific Training (Guard, Tackle, Center)](https://heavyweightlineman.com/#programs): position-specific technique, leverage and hand combat, scheme assignments, individual film breakdown
- [Off-Season Strength & Conditioning (All Levels)](https://heavyweightlineman.com/#programs): lineman-specific strength, explosive power, mobility, speed and agility, nutrition guidance

## Curriculum

Three-point stance and explosive get-off; pass protection footwork; run blocking schemes and leverage; hand placement and punch mechanics; anchor technique and base strength; film study and scheme recognition; pad level control; combo blocks and double-team technique.
